newsitem.title: USA: FSA qualifies 10 bond issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: FSA qualifies 10 bond issues for insurance.

text.p: FSA said Tuesday it qualified 10 bond issues for insurance slated for competitive sale today.
--Ottumwa, Iowa, $1.3 million and $1.7 million of GO bonds.
--New Buffalo Building, Mich., $1.5 million building authority bonds.
--South St Paul, Minn., $1.8 million and $2 million of GO bonds.
--San Juan County School District #22, N.M., $10 million of GO school building bonds.
--Windber Area School District, Pa., $4 million and $4.6 million of GO bonds.
--Grand Prairie, Texas, $3.2 million of certificates of obligation.
--Grand Prairie, Texas, $2.4 million of GO bonds.
--Kenosha County, Wis., $3.9 million of GO promissory notes.
--Kenosha County, Wis., $29 million of GO detention center notes.
